text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—That day, the gym was enveloped
in an extraordinary heat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Phew—... ngh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, communication with my triceps is flawless.
Condition is top-notch too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Today's the day, I can do this...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Did you hear?! Ryan-senpai is
going to challenge that barbell in the back...!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"That one that they say nobody can lift!?
Even for Ryan-senpai, isn't that impossible...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, don't worry!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's impossible or not—
is for these finely sculpted muscles to decide!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ryan-senpai! Do your be~st!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... E... ght...! N... ne...!
*pant*, *pant*—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Just one more, and that's three sets done!
Amazing! At this rate, we might really...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-senpai looks like she's struggling, though...!
Yooouuu can dooo iiit!!" || "Ryan-senpai looks like she's struggling, though...!
Keep fighting~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ――Yaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... gh!!
Muscle... possible... gh!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations!
I'm... so deeply moved!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —I'd be so happy if everyone learned that nothing is impossible with well-trained muscles!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her success at weightlifting,
Mejiro Ryan seems to have grown significantly!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Guh...!
My arms are already—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-senpai!
That was a great fight...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, thank you!
Looks like I still have plenty more training to do, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'll train more and more...
and show everyone the true potential of muscles!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she failed at weightlifting,
Mejiro Ryan seems to have grown even more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Roar, my muscllllleeeessssss
ssssssssss!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*...
――Muscles have no limits!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! Such marvelous strength,
Big Sister Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... I was stunned. I knew she was amazing,
but she went way beyond my expectations...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah— You two were watching!
I'm so glad!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Since you're here, why don't you two join in?
Let's sweat it out together and train to the limit!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I would be delighted to join you!
I want to become tough and strong just like you, Onee-sama~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If you two are doing it, maybe I will too.
Ah... but I'll just take it in moderation!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her huge success at weightlifting,
Mejiro Ryan seems to have grown considerably!
